name: What is the difference between antique door restoration and repair?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between antique door restoration and repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Antique door restoration is a comprehensive process that aims to return a door to its original historical condition and beauty, addressing all aspects from structural integrity to finish. Repair, on the other hand, typically focuses on fixing a specific problem, such as a broken panel or loose hinge, without necessarily undertaking a full aesthetic overhaul. We recommend restoration when the door has significant historical value or widespread damage, while repairs are suitable for isolated issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration is a comprehensive process to return a door to its original condition, while repair focuses on fixing specific issues. Choose based on historical value and damage extent.
